9287f7ca: ;
 .;This routine determines if a medical document
 .;has violated the processing time guidelines.
 .;DGJTFLAG is set to 1 if the status indicates
 .;the document is out of compliance.
 .;DGJTDL indicates how many days overdue.
514bf937: ;Process if status matches one defined in DGJTSTAT.

830eb231: ;
 .;If status is INCOMPLETE, determine number of days
 .;since creation date and compare with allowed time.
 .;Set DGJTFLAG and DGJTDL accordingly.

34ccf893: ;
 .;If status is TRANSCRIBED, determine number of days
 .;since transcription date and compare with allowed time.
 .;Set DGJTFLAG and DGJTDL accordingly.

f7bc5aff: ;
 .;If status is SIGNED and turnaround time is specified,
 .;determine number of days since transcription date and
 .;compare with allowed time. Set DGJTFLAG and DGJTDL accordingly.
